RESPIRATION. [26] [Chel.]
Great dyspnœa. θ Pneumonia.
Dyspnœa after awaking out of frightful dreams.
Breathes with great difficulty and a loud mucous rale. θ Influenza.
Difficult respiration with short fits of coughing, preceded by pain, first in right then left side of thorax.
Short and quick breathing ; with oppression, which is relieved by a few deep inspirations ; with anxiety, as if he must choke.
Shortness of breath and tight chest. θ Influenza.
Respiration improved in evening in bed.
Complaints of anxiety, tightness and pains in right side during inhalation ; on inspiration thorax is not distended.
Every day repeated attacks of difficult breathing and constriction of chest. θ Prosopalgia.
Hindrance to breathing as if by a tight girdle.
Tightness and oppression ; must loosen clothing ; > in open air.
Breathes short from stitch pains in chest.
On inspiration it seems as though something was pressing on chest, after dinner.
Bronchial respiration in pneumonia.
Interrupted speech.
Nightly attacks of asthma with a sense of constriction in chest ; region of diaphragm.
Spasm of respiratory muscles of thorax.
   

COUGH. [27] [Chel.]
Cough : violent, somewhat spasmodic, dry, in paroxysms ; hollow, short, exhausting, racking, as in consumption, with much expectoration from lungs, also with pain behind sternum, especially at night ; morning, with copious mucous expectoration.
Straining cough, < in morning, with much expectoration coming from lungs.
Violent, spasmodic, straining cough, bringing tears to eyes, lasting long, even awaking them from sleep.
Cough, with little expectoration ; hot spell every evening ; great emaciation.
Spasmodic cough without expectoration ; or, with forcible ejection of small lumps of mucus.
Cough, with painful contraction of whole abdomen with every cough.
Repeated attacks of short cough, with stitches in right side and difficulty of breathing.
Cough in paroxysms, with burning, shooting pains, and constant tickling in larynx.
Short spells of cough with difficult breathing, with pain first in right then left side of thorax.
Short cough with a little greyish phlegm. θ Pneumonia.
Painless, racking, fatiguing cough. θ Hepatic typhus.
Cough, excited by tickling in larynx, bringing tears to eyes ; by sensation of dust in trachea, throat, or behind sternum, not relieved by cough.
Cough re-echoes in stomach ; flying out of detached lumps of mucus when coughing. θ Whooping cough.
Cough with short breath ; with spasm of glottis on expiration.
Loose, rattling cough, remaining a long time after whooping cough or measles.
Loose morning cough, copious mucous expectoration. θ Pneumonia. θ Capillary bronchitis.
Cough with obstruction of ears, deafness.
Catarrhal cough.
Dry cough through day with pain and stitches in right side, with severe hoarseness each evening at five o'clock, so that her voice could scarcely be heard.
Cough with blood-streaked phlegm, or brownish-bloody sputa. θ Pneumonia.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Chel.]
Stitches under left clavicle and in region of right mamma.
Constrictive pressure below left clavicle extending to neck.
Pains, anxiety and tightness in upper part of chest. θ Pneumonia.
Stitches in left side towards left scapula.
Burning between chest and scapulæ, with internal heat and want of breath.
Shooting, jerking pains from lower part of sternum through to back.
Spasmodic pressure behind middle of sternum, awoke him at night ; extended into bronchi, with sensation of constriction in them.
Spasm of diaphragm.
Pain in sternum, directly over cardiac region, while yawning.
Periodic attacks of tightness and pain in chest along sternum. θ Acute rheumatism.
Pain internally behind sternum, especially noticed on inspiration.
Drawing from lower part of sternum towards right side around to spine ; sore pain, even touch of clothes increases it.
Violent stitches in lower portion of right side of thorax on inspiration, < by motion and by cough.
At 2 P. M. stitches and soreness in lungs, < by deep breathing, coughing or sneezing.
Stabbing in right side, close under mammary gland.
Stitches in forepart of lower portion of thorax, extending into intestines below navel.
Stitches under heart.
Violent pain in right side, in region of seventh and eighth ribs ; < by breathing, and movement ; followed by burning headache.
Painful tension on deep inspiration, all around inside of thorax at its base.
Stitches in chest, < right side.
Deep-seated pain in whole right side of chest.
Stitches in left chest on inspiring.
Pain deep down in chest, < on stooping low, quick walking, blowing nose, and sneezing.
Contused pain in chest, < by motion.
Stitches in left side prevent her from taking a deep breath.
Pressive pain in left side.
Oppression of chest ; clothing seemed too tight.
Tightness of chest during expiration.
Pressure on chest with dyspnœa.
Motion increases pains in chest.
Sudden, great anxiety, with palpitation.
Soreness in lower ribs, right side.
Dull throbbing in apices of lungs.
Stinging and soreness in lungs, with sneezing and coughing, or deep inhalations.
Inflammation of right lung, with persistent cough ; stitches, bloody expectoration, dyspnœa, and intense headache in forehead and vertex, sleeplessness and delirium, yellow, watery diarrhœa, tongue loaded, great prostration.
Lungs full of mucus, great oppression, desire to change place, anxiety ; loose, rattling cough ; dark red face, one ear cold the other warm, one foot cold the other warm ; violent motion of the alæ nasi ; palpitation forcible, stools thin, bright yellow. θ Capillary bronchitis. θ Pneumonia.
Shooting, stitch pains, through right lung to back ; short breathing ; must sit upright ; < during deep inspiration, movement and cough.
Hepatization of upper half of right lung ; pale as death ; countenance sunken ; constant stupor ; distortion of eyes ; slight convulsive twitches in face and limbs ; strong rattle in throat ; extreme weakness.
Inflammation of lower lobe of left lung, cough and bloody sputum, dyspnœa and frontal headache. θ Pneumonia.
In left lung soreness like a wound, by deep breathing, coughing and sneezing.
Hepatization of lungs. θ Pneumonia.
Hæmoptysis. θ Pneumonia.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Chel.]
Lancinating pains in heart.
Stitches in cardiac region, must breathe short, followed by strong palpitation and anxiety.
Violent stitches in region of heart.
Palpitation. θ Chorea.
Violent palpitation with tightness of chest. θ Mental affections.
Very irregular palpitation of heart. θ Hepatitis. θ Pneumonia.
Beating of heart so strong that clothing is lifted from chest. θ Hepatic affections.
Pulse : slow ; small and quick ; full and hard, though but slightly accelerated towards evening.
Pulse soft, not frequent. θ Cough.
Pulse irregular, 130, missed every fifth or sixth stroke. θ Influenza.
Pulse 100 and full. θ Acute rheumatism.
Pulse 115, and small. θ Pneumonia.
Stenocardia.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Chel.]
Lancinating pains in pectoral muscles.
Stitches in right mammary region.
Depression between ribs less perceptible.
Intercostal neuralgia.
Skin yellow on throat and chest.
Superficial ulceration extending downward from left mastoid process.
